## A real interface, not a mockup
Here is an actual delivery from the plugin: how the goal is written, how the interview is decided, h
ow the artifact runs in place at delivery time, and how the run is summarised. Real machine captures
(Windows 11 · DSH desktop, 2026-11-05), copied verbatim into `assets/screenshots/` — **not beautifi
ed, not stitched, not redrawn**.
▲ Goal “make a snake game” · mode and lineup · visual explosion — the interview (runtime / theme / m
otion) ticked and decided
▲ At delivery, the driver gateway runs the freshly shipped artifact while the chat keeps the smoke r
esult, the independent review and the real-render evidence
▲ Result: 2/2 passed · 0 blocked · 13m33s · 165.2K tokens · ¥1.66 — the artifact: NEON SERPENT

THE PET · LITTLE FAT FISH
## Sleeps, roams, and wakes up to work
Windows and DSH share the same character assets; the desktop copy ships as an installer, and the col
lapsed DSH token is the same pet. Transparent, always-on-top, draggable — the window holds the chara
cter and nothing else.
▲ Main window (character only) · first launch · the draggable token after collapsing the sidebar
▲ Five frames: click response · sleep · working · dragging · idle variant
→ 25 clips: click responses, a sleep chain, six work poses, drag feedback, idle variants
→ Roams every 18–28s while idle, then pauses and changes clip
→ Sleeps for 10 minutes; click to wake early, otherwise it keeps sleeping
→ Double-click wakes DSH and opens the hall; launches DSH if it is not running
→ A single click only pets it — it never wakes or resizes the DSH window; hover shows a pink Pop-sty
le status card (level · growth · satiety · mood · energy)
IDLE / FEED / SLEEP / WORK / DRAG · REAL FRAMES · MIT
WHY IT IS DIFFERENT
## Not another agent dashboard
Most agent UIs hand you a wall of logs. This one gives you a place: who is working, what is blocked,
what shipped — and the evidence that it shipped, all in the same spot.
| Pillar | What it means |

| **A HALL, NOT A DASHBOARD**
**01 A place, not a log wall** | Six clickable facilities, a live scen
e and an expandable right sidebar. Open a member conversation, expand the hall, review the delivery

— in one place. |
| **DELIVERY, NOT VIBES**
**02 Gates that prove delivery** | Task DAG, write scope
s, acceptance commands and independent review. Implementers cannot approve their own work; the host

re-runs the declared commands. |
| **ONE PET, TWO PLACES**
**03 The same pet in DSH and on Windows**
| Real frames: random idle, 18–28s roaming, click responses and a real 10-minute sleep. The collaps
ed DSH token is the same character. |
